rules.name: cash-refresh-20-environment-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, value_date, settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))=upper(:bu)

SELECT p.oid::regprocedure::text AS signature, md5(p.prosrc) AS body_hash, position('pg_try_advisory_xact_lock' in p.prosrc)>0 AS uses_try_lock, position('ANALYZE pg_temp.cb_refresh_input' in p.prosrc)>0 AS analyzes_refresh_input FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='opera' AND p.proname IN ('fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope','refresh_client_cash_balances')

SELECT 'spot_mapping' AS source, count(*) AS rows FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant UNION ALL SELECT 'threshold_mapping', count(*) FROM opera.client_threshold_master WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))=upper(:bu) UNION ALL SELECT 'fixings', count(*) FROM opera.client_account_cash_balance_fixing_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))=upper(:bu) UNION ALL SELECT 'balances', count(*) FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))=upper(:bu)

expect.reason: one valuation context per tenant and BU
input function must exist before volume/parity checks
